_comment: Raw mild steel: bare, uncoated carbon-steel sheet or plate as it comes from the stockholder, light grey, unpolished, with faint handling scratches and a few small spots of fresh oxide (ambientCG Metal002, CC0; tagged steel, scratches, silver, bumpy). Opaque: a solid metal; the scan's metalness map is 1 except in the oxide spots. The source says steel, not mild steel; ordinary bare structural steel is mild steel, so the name keeps the wish list's word. The source states no physical size: meters_per_tile 0.3 is a judgement from the oxide spots (2-5 mm). APPROXIMATE: no metal edge tint (F82 specular_color) or complex IOR (F-LC-6). Carries every relevant wear layer at 0 (C1): scratches (overlay 1, damage), pitting (overlay 2, corrosion pits), dust as a deposit (Phase10), gated by the Grime mask. Built by the Phase11 batch.
name: MildSteel_Raw_Clean_Base_s01_v01

sources.why: meters_per_tile 0.3 from the oxide spots (2-5 mm, 7-15 px of the 1024 px tile), since the source states no physical size. The scan's mean linear albedo (about 0.31, 0.32, 0.33) is left as scanned; it is darker than Physically Based 'Iron' (0.53, 0.513, 0.494), whose F82 tint and complex IOR the library does not carry either.
